historical.trigger: ITPL (International Tech Park Bangalore) + EPIP export-promotion IT boom, later amplified by Namma Metro Purple Line extension to Whitefield (Kadugodi)
Forum Mall (2004, Bangalore's first full-fledged mall) + IT/startup-hub boom (Flipkart, Ola, InMobi, Myntra), IIM-Bangalore proximity and Electronic City/ORR connectivity
100 Feet Road commercialization into a top retail/F&B high street + Namma Metro Purple Line Indira Nagar station, amplified by 1990s-2000s IT boom and CBD/MG Road proximity
Outer Ring Road employment belt + Silk Board flyover connectivity to Electronic City & Sarjapur/ORR tech corridor; HSR later became Bangalore's first officially recognized startup hub
Outer Ring Road (ORR) IT corridor completion opening land to IT campuses — RMZ Ecospace (2006), Embassy's ORR tech park, RMZ Ecoworld (2016) — creating Bangalore's densest tech-employment belt
Manyata Embassy Business Park (IT hub on ORR, ~300 acres, opened 2001) + Kempegowda International Airport on Bellary Road/NH-44 (opened May 2008), reinforced by ORR connectivity and upcoming metro

leading_indicators: Namma Metro Blue Line (ORR-Airport corridor, KIAL + Doddajala stations)
KIADB Aerospace Park (Boeing/Airbus/Wipro; SAP, NTT Data campuses)
Bangalore Airport City / KWIN City township
emerging.growth_thesis: Airport metro + aerospace/GCC job engine + Foxconn manufacturing base convert a low-base airport fringe into North Bengaluru's fastest-appreciating micro-market (~13.5% CAGR).

leading_indicators: KIADB IT Hardware Park (~47 electronics firms)
emerging.growth_thesis: Airport + live aerospace/hardware SEZ + incoming GCC-IT campuses turn a low-base agrarian belt into North Bangalore's highest long-run appreciation corridor, with metro/PRR as next re-rating catalysts.

leading_indicators: Peripheral Ring Road / Bengaluru Business Corridor (74km)
Wipro SEZ, RGA Tech Park, Global Technology Park
direct links to Electronic City / ORR / Whitefield
emerging.growth_thesis: Proven IT-employment corridor (+84% over 3yr) now consolidating flat, with two large announced catalysts (Hebbal-Sarjapur metro + PRR) positioned to re-accelerate once construction visibly begins.

leading_indicators: Yellow Line Metro (RV Road-Bommasandra, 3 EC stations, live Aug 2025)
GCC/IT SEZ density (TCS 1.4M sqft, Tech Mahindra, HPE, Bosch, Biocon)
emerging.growth_thesis: Metro-connected (Yellow Line operational) IT/GCC hub with the lowest entry price of any south-Bangalore tech corridor; Phase 2 posted ~43% YoY with durable GCC leasing upside.

leading_indicators: Yellow Line Metro terminus at Bommasandra (operational Aug 2025)
Hosur EV/manufacturing spillover (Tata Electronics, Ola, Ather/TVS)
emerging.growth_thesis: Operational Yellow Line at Bommasandra + STRR Attibele link + Hosur's EV-manufacturing job engine convert an affordable ₹6,600/sqft corridor into Bangalore's next south-peripheral appreciation belt (~9% YoY).

leading_indicators: Satellite Town Ring Road (STRR/NH-948A, Hoskote-Hosur ~99% done, June 2026 target)
warehousing/logistics parks (Sumadhura ~100-500 acres, Welspun One ~51 acres)
emerging.growth_thesis: Logistics-and-industrial land-use flip (KIADB + Sumadhura/Welspun warehousing) with near-complete STRR unlocking a full ring bypass, converting a cheap NH-75 outer node into an East-Bangalore appreciation corridor.

leading_indicators: Green Line Metro spine (terminus Silk Institute, operational since Jan 2021)
NICE Road (~20-25 min to Electronic City GCCs)
emerging.growth_thesis: Operational Green Line spine + NICE Road's 20-min link to Electronic City GCCs, with PRR-2 as next catalyst, drives steady ~15% YoY flat appreciation on a corridor still priced below eastern-Bangalore hubs.

leading_indicators: Green Line Metro operational to Madavara/Chikkabidarakallu (opened Nov 2024)
proposed metro extension Madavara-Tumakuru (₹20,649cr, DPR stage)
KIADB industrial takeover (~2,800 acres), ABB investment, KWIN City / Dabaspet-Peenya industrial belt
emerging.growth_thesis: Nelamangala/outer Tumkur Road node riding STRR completion + KIADB/KWIN City industrial land-use flip (land +39% YoY) with metro creeping outward — cheapest large emerging corridor in the west.
